To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

multinational firms can benefit from uncertainty through coordination of activities located in dispersed subsidiaries, and that the value of this coordination is equivalent to owning an options on the real exchange rate.
multinational corporations can benefit from the operating flexibility to switch production between two countries, and that this operating flexibility can be viewed as an option.

the multinational network provides the firm with the option to shift production between plants located in two different countries, that the option value depends on the exchange rate, that the value of operating flexibility increases with the exchange rate volatility, and that the firm's option value increases as it expands the network.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the option value of multinationality.
the value of the multinational corporation as a network of activities, and the role of the multinational in the coordination of dispersed activities.
the role of the multinational network in providing a firm with the flexibility to respond to uncertainty.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the multinational corporation is a global network of activities that has the option value of operating flexibility to shift activities between subsidiaries.
the multinational network is an option, and its value is a function of the real exchange rate.
the multinational network is not only a way to reduce risk but also a way to increase the option value of the firm.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the option value of multinationality can be enhanced through operating flexibility and the coordination of activities located in geographically dispersed plants.
the multinational network is a valuable option for a firm, and that the management of this network requires new tools and new thinking.
multinational corporations are not just networks of activities, but are also networks of options.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the multinational firm's network of activities can be managed to benefit from the option value of the network.
multinational firms have a strong incentive to maintain a network of activities that are dispersed geographically.
the option value of the network is a key element in the decision making process of the MNC.
